how: A member proposes the flag and reports placing its first tile before others answer.
Flag and placeheart calls recruit members into specific placement work.
Bare replies accept flag and heart calls without requesting anything in return.
Members propose flags, a wordmark, national figures, and emblems as competing representations.
Participants count workers, report completion, and recount how the call became a finished flag.
Anchor coordinates and a replacement heart template turn a location into instructions for placement.
An operator runs autorepair and explicitly controls whether its fixed design remains locked.
Members request maintenance, defend damaged work, and watch the heart across the night.
Attribution is pursued through questions about who made a heart rather than assumed from its national design.
Participants urge expansion around existing art and refuse a war with earlier, larger neighbours.
Members clarify boundaries, invoke agreements, and protect a negotiated no-go zone.
Neighbour assistance includes offers, reciprocal defence, joint heart requests, and thanks.
A shared heart agreed across two rooms instantiates the joint-mark end of coalition activity.
Heart builders claim authority to retain rainbow designs while another host grants provisional permission.
Members carry a heart plan across rooms and report private messages maintaining neighbour peace.
Members propose moving a flag that is hard to hold and restarting lost hearts elsewhere.
An early response doubts whether the room can draw and defend the flag without many more hands.
Members propose converting an American flag and replacing neighbouring labels, with a later outside recruitment report.
Competitive talk appears as enthusiasm for a pixel war and a boast about globally distributed defenders.
Members celebrate intact flags, thank helpers, and claim specific defensive or placement labour.
Members share the final version, mourn the ending, and recount the event after placement stops.
A participant wishes to print and mount the shared final canvas as a physical keepsake.
Moderators establish an official thread, remove competing posts, and plan restoration of the ordinary sticky.
The separate fuel-ban prank is produced, detected through its date, criticised, and enjoyed.
Anthem replies, national figures, and monyet jokes carry familiar belonging into canvas work.
A post-event defence of the unfinished Singapore image corrects blame through an attributed account of lost time.
Rule disputes and a declined personal commitment do not show members contesting an envoy's power to bind the room.
The MH17 argument does not establish that the room carried a pre-existing quarrel into its own attack.
National framing and an unidentified MH17 maker cannot establish that an inherited tie caused a room-authorised attack.
One room cannot test the global frequency claim, although moderators visibly decide the order of its discussion.
A completion account explicitly recalls the drawing call and links it to the finished flag.
Proposal, first placement, and recruitment coexist in the initiating turn without a separately evidenced starter-to-call mechanism.
The same item announces completion and asks for defence, while later maintenance calls name active undoing.
A contested border elicits conditional help if the rival relocates and releases defensive pixels.
A stated peace agreement directly supplies the reason to preserve a no-go zone.
Script operation supports automated upkeep, but the coded evidence does not establish that manual capacity was necessarily exhausted.
A participant links the building call to a finished flag that members announce and celebrate.
Celebration and final-version sharing are observed without a passage establishing that celebration caused record-making.
Sharing the final version receives a wish to print and display that same canvas.
Moving can follow contested permission or scripting asymmetry without a demonstrated room-wide shortage of hands.
A template enables the proposed alternative build without establishing agreement over the earlier location dispute.
Two direct call-and-answer pairs show bare joining, while silent participation remains outside the written evidence.
Incoming help is explicitly offered because the helper finished its own work, rather than solely because defenders requested scarce hands.
An offer of help precedes the question clarifying project boundaries, so border settlement is not a necessary prior step.
Recruitment and conversion proposals occur together without showing that recruitment caused attacking conduct.
An overwrite proposal directly receives a refusal that offers helping neighbours as the alternative.
Attack proposals and agreement reminders are visible without a passage demonstrating that the former produced the latter.
The proposal to change an American flag receives an explicit welcome to pixel war with Americans.
A shared heart is observed, but common threat is not established as the reason coalition work formed.
A complaint about excessive canvas posts receives a megathread request and an explicit one-thread coordination plan.
The treaty exchange contests rules and a personal commitment without demonstrating a dispute over who may represent all placers.
Shared design changes require releasing an autorepair lock, and the operator reports doing so as planned.
Joint heart construction depends on suspending a script that would otherwise preserve the previous design.
Helping defenders must recognise a collaborator's changing design and pause repairs while new work is built.
A neighbour's request to restore its design can trigger relocation even without confirmed erasure.
Relocation returns participants to templating, first-pixel placement, and publishing the new build in the sticky.
A member can advocate releasing the space because the shared objective was achieved rather than because the room lacked capacity.
Host permission remains provisional and contestable where written rules do not establish the asserted restriction.
This record supports correction of an event account but leaves cleanup and disputes over preserving damage unobserved.
Official consolidation can coexist with an unresolved objection that separate posts improve visibility and cooperation.
Explanation of basic placement mechanics occurs after the final canvas is shared, extending sensemaking beyond initial mobilisation.
Participants continue contesting the appearance of the accepted final mark after placement has ended.
